articles.headline: RBI puts rate cuts on ice citing inflation risks
articles.brief: The Reserve Bank of India has signaled a cautious approach, pausing potential rate cuts as widening inflation risks cloud the country's otherwise resilient 7.1% economic growth trajectory.

articles.headline: HDFC Bank probes internal leak of confidential information
articles.brief: An internal investigation by India's HDFC Bank has revealed that certain executives allegedly leaked confidential information, prompting further scrutiny into corporate governance and data security at the lender.

articles.headline: Meta ordered to pay $25 billion in New Mexico case
articles.brief: A New Mexico court has ordered Meta Platforms to pay a $25 billion penalty following a high-profile trial over data privacy practices, misleading user policies, and the handling of harmful content.

articles.headline: Global government websites face outages due to PHP flaw
articles.brief: A decades-old vulnerability discovered in PHP using advanced artificial intelligence tools has triggered widespread outages across various government portals and public institution websites worldwide.

articles.headline: Saudi authorities report casualties following drone attack on oil facility
articles.brief: A drone strike on a Saudi Arabian oil facility resulted in falling debris that killed two people and injured several foreign nationals, escalating security and infrastructure concerns in the region.

articles.headline: India issues travel advisory for France amid violent protests
articles.brief: The Indian Embassy in France has urged citizens to remain vigilant, avoid large crowds, and comply with local curfews as violent protests over rising living costs prompt fresh demonstrations.

articles.headline: J&K and Ladakh High Court questions vague preventive detention orders
articles.brief: A single bench of the Jammu and Kashmir and Ladakh High Court criticized vague detention orders, emphasizing that preventive detention requires the highest degree of constitutional responsibility.

articles.headline: BJD criticizes BJP over political attacks on Naveen Patnaik
articles.brief: The Biju Janata Dal has strongly slammed the BJP for personal attacks against Naveen Patnaik, rejecting allegations that his political demands aim to destabilize the state or country.

articles.headline: Non-bank lenders flag early stress signs in gold loans
articles.brief: Top Indian non-banking financial companies have reported early signs of asset quality stress in short-tenure gold loans, driven by borrowers with histories of serious financial delinquencies.

articles.headline: Investors flood Jio IPO on opening day of massive offering
articles.brief: The initial public offering of Jio has drawn heavy investor participation on its first day, bolstering rupee recovery and driving strong capital inflows into the Indian market.

articles.headline: West Bengal forms SIT to investigate Durga Puja stampede
articles.brief: The West Bengal government has established a Special Investigation Team headed by a retired justice to probe the circumstances surrounding a deadly stampede at a Durga Puja pandal.

articles.headline: Authorities rescue 103 protected birds and turtles in Delhi
articles.brief: Delhi police and wildlife authorities successfully rescued 103 protected birds and turtles from a local pet shop in Moti Nagar, with legal action currently underway against the offenders.

articles.headline: Health experts urge strict regulations on added sugars in infant food
articles.brief: Following recent drafts and regulatory debates, public health advocates are pressing authorities to expand restrictions on added sugars across all commercial infant food products to protect children.
